== Summary ==
Cover banner of [[Domain Of Evil (Virtual Block 6)|Domain Of Evil]], release 6.2 of [[Virtual Block 6]], from page 1 of its release PDF. The cover reads "Official text as of December 7, 2009". The file was created on 15 December 2009.

Source: [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock6_2.pdf VirtualBlock6_2.pdf], res.starwarsccg.org. Page 1 rendered at 158 dpi, the resolution of the embedded cover images, and cropped to the banner (1028&times;633 pixels). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020174418/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock6_2.pdf Internet Archive].
